# Multiplayer API (api.michitai.com)

> Cross-platform multiplayer backend for game developers. Provides player accounts,
> game rooms, matchmaking, leaderboards and realtime updates via a REST API and
> official SDKs. Open source under the MIT No Attribution (MIT-0) license —
> free to use, modify and redistribute, commercially or otherwise, with no
> attribution required.

Author: Nichita Levandovici (Michitai), Republic of Moldova
Contact: support@michitai.com

## Features

- Player management: registration, authentication, sessions, heartbeats,
  custom JSON player data, timed/permanent bans
- Game rooms: create/join/leave, room state updates, realtime action broadcast
- Matchmaking: lobbies, join requests, password-protected matches, direct join
- Leaderboards: score submission and ranked queries per game
- Game data storage: structured JSON persistence
- Server time sync endpoint
- Multi-region server network (Europe, North America, Asia, India)

## SDKs / Documentation

- [REST API docs](https://api.michitai.com/api/index.php): language-agnostic HTTP endpoints
- [Unity SDK](https://api.michitai.com/unity/index.php): C# / JsonUtility
- [Java SDK](https://api.michitai.com/java/index.php): Jackson-based client
- [.NET SDK](https://api.michitai.com/dotnet/index.php): System.Text.Json client
- [C++ SDK](https://api.michitai.com/cpp/index.php): nlohmann::json client

## Main endpoints

- `/api/game_players.php` — register, login, heartbeat, logout, rename, ban
- `/api/game_room.php` — room lifecycle and player actions
- `/api/matchmaking.php` — lobbies and join requests
- `/api/leaderboard.php` — score submission and queries
- `/api/game_data.php` — game data storage
- `/api/realtime.php` — realtime room events
- `/api/time.php` — server time (UTC)

Authentication: `api_token` query parameter for developer calls,
`player_token` for player-scoped calls.

## Pricing

- Free: 128 MB storage, 1 game, 100 concurrent players
- Standard ($25/mo): 512 MB, 1 game, 1K concurrent players
- Pro ($300/mo): 1 GB, 3 games, 2K concurrent players
